tbesh_subentries.definition_html:

1a) (Qal) to circumcise

1c1) of destruction (fig.)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise); by implication, to blunt; figuratively, to destroy
strongs_1890.kjv_def: circumcise(-ing), selves), cut down (in pieces), destroy, [idiom] must needs.
